rows.text: You're a Masked Fool. You might not have the sharpest punchlines among the tavern regulars, but you live for the drinksmith's custom-mixed jokes. They're as satisfying as that first big stretch in the morning.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You push open the tavern doors. The drinksmith is gone, leaving only a bunch of wispae and a few odd-looking mixed jokes on the counter. One is a blue-flamed plasma, another is crystal clear and shimmers with metaphorical light, and the last is a cup of bubbling, scalding black mud.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Looks like you'll have to help yourself today.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: At first, you don't react, just tasting a bit of sweetness. But then, an incredible power surges through you. You feel like you could fly into the sky and punch the moon until it explodes. You're absolutely fired up.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You down the metaphorical light, and your body starts shifting within the symbolic realm. You're no longer human. You're a reed, then iron, then the sum of all social relations. You keep changing forms right in front of everyone, only returning to your original self when the bar closes.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You drink the cup of black mud... honestly, this thing needs a warning label. Before long, your stomach starts staging a protest, and your face twists into a grimace that's definitely not a smile.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Oh boy, looks like you've had a bit too much bad humor, or what we call "cringe jokes." You've got a massive headache from all the joking, and you won't be laughing again for a long, long time.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
